reactions.label: quietly_horrified
reactions.prompt: The same man holds direct eye contact, then registers quiet horror only through a subtle widening of the eyes and a tiny tightening of the mouth before returning almost to neutral. Minimal natural movement, realistic blinking and breathing. Preserve exact identity, facial anatomy, age, hairline and skin. No speech, no theatrical reaction, no camera movement, no face morphing.

reactions.label: cautious_optimism
reactions.prompt: The same man listens slightly off-camera, then gives a tiny restrained nod with a barely perceptible softening around the eyes, suggesting cautious optimism rather than approval. Preserve exact identity, age, hairline, face and proportions. No speech, no broad smile, no camera movement, no face morphing.

reactions.label: endpoint_disbelief
reactions.prompt: The same man looks down briefly as if reading an endpoint, then back to camera with restrained disbelief: slight brow furrow and a tiny exhale visible in the shoulders. Preserve exact identity and facial anatomy. No speech, no grin, no exaggerated acting, no camera movement, no face morphing.

reactions.label: deadpan_stare
reactions.prompt: The same man gives a steady deadpan stare into camera for a beat, one natural blink, then the tiniest eyebrow movement as if the absurdity speaks for itself. Preserve exact identity, age, hairline, skin and face. No speech, no smile, no head movement beyond natural breathing, no camera movement, no face morphing.
